research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Liberate Bio is engaged in developing lipid compounds and compositions, as described in 'Lipid compounds, compositions, and uses thereof.' These compositions, including lipid nanoparticle formulations, are designed for delivering active agents such as polynucleotides to cells or tissues. Their research and development focus on non-viral delivery technologies for nucleic acid cargoes, addressing the targeted delivery of genetic material for therapeutic applications.

overview_description.description: Liberate Bio focuses on advancing non-viral delivery technologies for nucleic acid cargoes such as ASOs and siRNAs. The company aims to develop new vehicles to deliver oligonucleotide cargos, addressing genetic disorders. With a team of 50 employees, Liberate Bio operates within the biotechnology industry, working on innovative solutions for targeted delivery systems.
